description:
Advanced Windows Network Adapter Profile & Diagnostics Tool

Etherprof is a fast, specialized Windows utility for network engineers and power users to quickly capture, manage, switch network adapter configurations (static IP, DHCP, gateway, DNS), monitor Wi-Fi, run continuous visual pings with history trails, and diagnose connection health.
- Added Public IP address display and ASN/organization resolution under the Online indicator with click-to-copy
- Added "Ping Similar IP..." context menu option to active ping targets with pre-selected network prefix and last octet focus
- Added real-time Network Load HUD tracking interface throughput (Mbps) and session/total traffic
